project: Voderberg contour solver - integrated joint-boundary release

placement_enumerator.description: Finite exhaustive enumeration of pole-image placements and contact-imposed parities.

formal_word_solver.description: Every emitted terminal profile is checked, but the audit explores only configured depth/state bounds.

point_angle_solver.description: Exact signed angle classes and forced-zero point turns.

total_turn_filter.description: Exact necessary total-turn feasibility test in the symbolic model.

pole_angle_filter.description: Exact necessary simultaneous inequalities at P0 and P1.

translation_holonomy_filter.description: Rejects only formally proved chord-closure contradictions; undecided systems are retained.

forced_point_coincidence.description: Standalone prototype, not integrated into core status.

external_boundary_builder.description: Constructs the shared inner/outer boundary system and exact linear turn constraints as a separate report layer.

joint_translation_dreal.description: For the encoded model, dReal UNSAT is a sound discard; delta-sat is only a candidate and the model is not yet the complete rigid-tile realization problem.

notes: Core retained/rejected status is unchanged by the experimental layer.
Experimental exact contradictions are reported separately.
dReal UNSAT is sound for the encoded model; delta-sat is only a candidate.
The formal word audit is bounded by max depth and max states.
